name: AL-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a +17 Republican partisan lean
Incumbent Gary Palmer running with a large fundraising edge
Democratic challenger Maurice Mercer has raised only about $6,500
Prediction markets price the Republican at roughly 97%
model.rationale: The district's deep Republican lean, Palmer's incumbency and roughly 160-to-1 fundraising advantage, and markets pricing the race at 97% Republican all point the same direction, with no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention for the Democrat, which shows no sign of materializing, is the only plausible source of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gary Palmer, the Republican incumbent, is heavily favored to win a sixth term in this Birmingham-area district that leans about 17 points Republican. He has raised more than $1 million and holds a cash advantage, while Democrat Maurice Mercer has raised only a few thousand dollars and has no outside support on record. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Palmer roughly a 97% chance of winning.

The fundamentals leave little room for doubt: the partisan lean, incumbency, and money gap all point the same way. The forecast expects Palmer to win by a margin in the high teens, with the race rated Safe Republican.
